createCharacter.heading: Who is your character
createCharacter.callingHint: Some of these already know you.
createCharacter.help: Upload a photo — it becomes your avatar everywhere. Until you answer a calling you play as Unaffiliated, and every path is open to you.

editCharacter.notOwner: You can only edit your own character.
editCharacter.heading: Edit character
editCharacter.intro: Your character is yours before any faction is. Set your portrait, name and story — it follows you onto every task and praxis you submit.
editCharacter.avatarHint: Square image, at least 240px. Your monogram “{{initial}}” shows until you add one — framed in the full spectrum, since every path is still open to you.
editCharacter.factionHelp: Join a faction from the Factions tab. It re-skins your whole app.
editCharacter.deleteConfirm: Delete this character? This can't be undone.

errors.titleTooLong: Title must be 200 characters or fewer.
errors.saveDraft: Could not save your draft — your writing is still here, so try again in a moment.
errors.kick: Could not remove {{name}} from the collab.
errors.duelUnderway: This duel is already underway — it can't be cancelled from here.

confirm.dropTask: Your draft goes with it, and this can't be undone.
confirm.dropDuelSideTitle: Drop this task and end the duel?
confirm.dropDuelSide: The duel ends for both of you, and your draft goes with it — neither can be undone.
confirm.dropDuelSideNote: Your opponent keeps their praxis as an ordinary solo — no forfeit penalty.
confirm.leaveDuel: Switching mode cancels the duel challenge attached to this praxis.
confirm.soloDropsCoauthors: Switching to solo removes your co-authors from this praxis — your draft stays.
confirm.duelDropsCoauthors: Switching to a duel removes your co-authors from this praxis — your draft stays.
confirm.dissolveDuel: It ends for both of you, and each side scores as an ordinary praxis — no forfeit penalty.

attach.pickerTitle: Attach a metatask to this praxis
attach.pickerSubtitle: Pin one extra condition to earn its bonus on completion.
attach.pending: Attaching the {{faction}} metatask · +{{points}} pts on completion
attach.removeBody: This removes the {{faction}} metatask and its +{{points}} pts bonus.

invite.addDescription: Ask somebody else onto this collab.

collab.progressAria: {{cast}} of {{total}} members have approved the proposal
collab.bannerHoldout: A proposal is live and waiting on you.
collab.bannerPublished: Every member approved. Every member is credited.
collab.rosterAwaitingAlone: Nobody else has joined this collab yet.
collab.doneDescription: Tells the crew your part is finished. It starts nothing and stops nothing, and you can take it back.
collab.proposeDescription: Opens the publish window and counts as your approval.
collab.proposeConfirm: This opens the publish window for the whole crew and counts as your approval. The praxis publishes as soon as every member has approved, or on its own once the window runs out. Anyone editing cancels it.
collab.approveDescription: Says you are happy with the text as it stands. The praxis publishes once every member has approved.
collab.withdrawDescription: Ends the publish window and clears every approval, yours included. The praxis goes back to drafting.
collab.editCancelsConfirm: A proposal is live. Editing here ends the publish window and clears every member's approval, yours included, and the praxis goes back to drafting.
collab.successBody: Every part is in — your collab is public and open to voting.
collab.leaveDescription: Bow out of this collab. The others keep the praxis and carry on without you.
collab.leaveConfirm: You come off the crew and the others carry on with the praxis without you. Getting back in takes a fresh invite.
collab.leaveConfirmSolo: You are one of two. When you go, the member who stays holds it alone — the praxis turns solo, and is scored as a solo praxis from then on.
collab.leaveConfirmLast: You are the last one on this collab, so leaving drops the praxis itself.
collab.kickConfirm: {{name}} comes off this collab. It also clears every approval, yours included, and sends the group back to drafting.
collab.deleteDescription: Destroys the whole collab — every member's part goes with it. To bow out on your own, leave instead.
collab.deleteConfirm: Delete this collab? It is destroyed for everyone, including the parts the other members have already put in. If you only want out yourself, leave instead.
collab.awaitingBody: Your approval is in. The praxis publishes once every member has approved, or on its own when the publish window runs out. Nothing is locked — anyone may still edit the write-up, and an edit cancels the proposal and clears every approval.
collab.awaitingWriteUpEmpty: There is no write-up yet — the title is all there is.
collab.awaitingEditDescription: Takes the praxis back to drafting so the crew can change it. It cancels the publish window and clears every member's approval — an edit means the group is not done.
collab.awaitingEditConfirm: Editing cancels the proposal. The publish window ends, every member's approval is cleared, yours included, and the praxis goes back to drafting.
collab.awaitingClockCaption: Silence is consent: after {{days}} days with nobody editing, this goes live on its own.
collab.awaitingClockAria: {{days}} days and {{hours}} hours left before this publishes itself
collab.holdoutClockLineLapsed: Publishes without your approval at any moment.
collab.holdoutClockCaption: Approve it and it publishes as soon as everyone has. Or keep writing — an edit cancels the window, and nothing stops you editing.
collab.completedBody: Every part is in. The praxis is public and open to voting.
collab.duelCompletedBody: Both entries are submitted. The duel is public and open to voting.
collab.duelCompletedPlaceholder: Their entry is on the praxis page.
collab.duelPendingLine: Submitted {{elapsed}}. {{name}} has not answered the challenge yet.
collab.duelPullBackDescription: Takes your entry back out so you can change it. The duel is untouched until it settles, so this costs you nothing.
collab.nudgeSentAria: You already nudged {{name}} today — you can nudge them again tomorrow
collab.nudgeDescription: Sends one reminder to their feed. Once a day, and it is signed with your name.
collab.nudgeFeedAction: nudged you to submit your part of
collab.nudgeCrewDescription: One reminder each to everyone who has not submitted. Once a day per person, signed with your name.
collab.nudgeCrewResultPartial: Nudged {{sent}} of {{total}} — {{skipped}} already nudged today. They can be nudged again tomorrow.

composer.bodyUnreachable: The shared write-up would not open, so this editor cannot take text. Reload the page to try again.
composer.bodyProposalLive: A proposal is live. You can still write — the first edit cancels the publish window and clears every approval.
composer.proofButton:
Drop a photo of the work
or browse files
composer.proofHelper: Photos, clips or receipts — max 50 MB each.
composer.publishNeedsTitle: Add a title before you submit — the Title box is at the top of this sheet.

successTask.heading: Task proposed!
successTask.body: An admin will review it soon. Only admins can see it for its first {{hours}} hours; other players see it after that.

successMeta.heading: Metatask proposed!
successMeta.body: An admin will review it, and only admins can see it for its first {{hours}} hours; other players see it after that. Once activated it is listed under {{faction}}, which records who issued it rather than who may use it: players of any faction can apply it to their praxis for a points bonus.

name.label: Task name
name.tooLong: Task name must be 200 characters or fewer.

description.label: Description
description.tooLong: Description must be 5000 characters or fewer.

submit.note: Your proposal goes to admin for review. Only admins can see it for its first {{hours}} hours; other players see it after that.
